details: Bitcoin's rally towards $85,000 was short-lived, with the cryptocurrency reversing gains and trading around $82,799. The decline tracked stock futures lower, driven by resurfacing concerns over the sustainability of the artificial intelligence (AI) boom. Despite the pullback, Bitcoin has held above a key support level of $82,500 over the past 24 hours.
title: Bitcoin Reverses Gains After Approaching $85,000 Amid AI Jitters

details: XRP's market capitalization saw a significant increase of approximately $4.1 billion on October 21st. This surge was attributed to a broader rebound across major cryptocurrencies and a short squeeze in the derivatives market, signaling renewed demand for the asset despite earlier declines in the month due to inflation concerns.
title: Over $4 Billion Flows Into XRP in a Day

details: Iran has reiterated its determination to maintain its uranium enrichment program despite increased regional tensions and a flurry of diplomatic meetings. Tehran stated it had "nothing new" to communicate to Washington following recent nuclear proposals, contributing to ongoing fears of escalating conflict in the Middle East.
title: Iran Determined to Keep Uranium Amid Increased War Odds

details: The US State Department has ordered some diplomats and their families to leave Saudi Arabia due to a series of near-daily attacks, primarily from Iranian-backed Houthis in Yemen. These attacks have targeted civilian airports and critical infrastructure, raising concerns about regional instability and the potential for a wider conflict.
title: US Orders Diplomats to Leave Saudi Arabia Amid Houthi Attacks

details: President Donald Trump is scheduled to highlight his administration's efforts to combat foreign criminal networks involved in fraudulent cryptocurrency investments. The White House will detail ongoing initiatives to seize fraudulent crypto websites as part of a broader cybercrime prevention event.
title: Trump to Highlight Crackdown on Overseas Crypto Scams
